notes_for_editor: Built year of the original 80 ft tower is not in any source, so the story says only that it was later torn down. Mary Kennedy's 1940s tenure comes from one fan site (Geocities.ws, sourced from a family photo), so no staffed event with a year is recorded. The 1959 replacement is consistent across Canada Lookouts and the two Geocities pages. The 1965 TV use is cited to the oldtowers5 page, which says the 100 ft replacement was the one used on The Forest Rangers. The oldtowers10 photo caption can be read as saying the original 80 ft tower was used on the show, so it is not cited for that claim. Oldtowers10 calls the replacement the 'Joe Tower', a nickname not used elsewhere, so the name was left out. The agency fact is Ontario-wide, from a Bay Today article about Ontario towers generally, not a Widdifield-specific record. Firelookout.ca gives no height, access or visit information, so access, visit and height_m are omitted; the brief's access 'unknown' stands. No source says whether the 1959 steel frame is the structure used today. No new photos with a usable licence were found. Fact-check 2026-10-20: figures now read metres first with feet in brackets; 'through the 1940s' changed to 'in the 1940s' because the sources say 'in'; the 1965 claim re-cited as above; sentences that copied quote wording were reworded.
